# Justin He

> Personal site of Justin He — engineer, founder of dori, previously Valon and DoorDash. The site holds a short project index, occasional writing, hobbies, and a few standalone practice notes.

The homepage is a plain single-page index. Project, blog, and hobby entries live at `/projects/<id>`, `/blog/<id>`, and `/hobbies/<id>`. Pages A, B, and C are self-contained practice essays, unrelated to the rest of the site.

## Main

- [Home](https://justinhe.com/): Name, project index, and links to LinkedIn, GitHub, and resume.
- [Projects](https://justinhe.com/projects): Things built, with short captions and dates.
- [Blog](https://justinhe.com/blog): Occasional writing.
- [Hobbies](https://justinhe.com/hobbies): Surfing, climbing, and photos from elsewhere.

## Practice notes

- [A — Color Theory](https://justinhe.com/a): The color wheel, the three dimensions of color, harmony schemes, and why perceptual color spaces beat raw RGB interpolation.
- [B — A History of Martians](https://justinhe.com/b): Martians as an idea — Schiaparelli's canals, Lowell, Wells and Bradbury, the Face on Mars, and what spacecraft actually found.
- [C — The Shipping Container](https://justinhe.com/c): How a standardized steel box rearranged world trade, emptied the working waterfront, and made globalization cheap.

## Optional

- [Resume (PDF)](https://justinhe.com/justin_he_resume_2026.pdf): Current resume.
- [Sitemap](https://justinhe.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexed URLs.
